Experimental

MCP connects GChat to tools from other apps and services. Select Add tool connection and use the setup details supplied by the tool provider. You can then turn each connection on or off below.
Browse tools that support MCP at mcp.so
Time allowed for a tool response (seconds)
How long GChat waits for a connected tool to finish before showing a timeout. Increase this only if a tool normally needs longer.
